title: Judge-debt door: own its route, grandfather pre-door caps, offer a deferral, fix the archived remedy
action: Three review P1/P2 fixes in one door. (1) ROUTE OWNERSHIP (P1): feature_route (close.rs:390-403) takes the default-state route only when it belongs to the closing feature — reuse route_belongs_to_feature (verbs/state_group/workflows.rs:683, rti-1) or compare state.route.feature; when the state route names another feature, fall back to the lane record own mode ONLY when that mode names a lane class (docs/tiny/small/spike/standard/high-risk — mode is usually "feature" and must then read as no opinion), else None. Precedent for the identity check: gated_add_refusal (verbs/cells/handlers_write.rs:119,133-142). (2) GRANDFATHER (P1): judge_debt (close.rs:405-426) counts only cells whose trace.capped_at is at or after a named constant JUDGE_DOOR_INTRODUCED_AT = "2026-08-11T00:00:00.000Z" with a comment stating why (the door shipped that day; 122 capped behavior_change cells predate it, 10 judged — blocking every legacy close is not a migration path). A cell with no capped_at counts as pre-door. (3) DEFERRAL + REMEDY (P2): mirror the scribing-debt escape (close.rs:583-588) — a logged decision tagged judge-deferral naming the feature clears the door, and the door detail says so; when an offending cell id resolves under archive, the detail names bee cells unarchive --feature <f> BEFORE the judge-record command (cells judge-record refuses archived cells, verbs/cells/util.rs:254). Tests: state route naming ANOTHER feature gives no opinion (both directions — a small feature must not grow the door, a standard feature must not lose it); lane mode "feature" is not a lane class; pre-door capped_at is not debt; post-door capped_at is; a judge-deferral decision clears it; an archived offender names unarchive first.

truths: A route owned by another feature is never read as this feature route
Cells capped before the door shipped are not debt
A recorded judge-deferral decision clears the door
An archived offender the remedy names unarchive first
Existing wfl-3/wfl-5 door tests still pass or are updated with a stated reason
